name: gnnepcsaft-mcp-server

tools.name: batch_predict_pcsaft_parameters
tools.description:
Predict PC-SAFT parameters
    `[m, sigma, epsilon/kB, kappa_ab, epsilon_ab/kB, dipole moment, na, nb, MW]`
    for a list of SMILES with the GNNPCSAFT model.

    Args:
      smiles (List[str]): SMILES of the molecules.

tools.name: batch_critical_points
tools.description:
Calculates critical points `[Temperature (K), Pressure (Pa), Density (mol/m³)]` with PC-SAFT
    for a list of SMILES. The GNNPCSAFT model is used to predict PCSAFT parameters.

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES.

tools.name: batch_pure_density
tools.description:
Calculates pure liquid density in `mol/m³` with PC-SAFT for a list of SMILES.
    The state is the same for all molecules. The GNNPCSAFT model is used to predict
    PCSAFT parameters.

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES.
        state: A list with
         `[Temperature (K), Pressure (Pa)]`.

tools.name: batch_pure_h_lv
tools.description:
Calculates pure liquid enthalpy of vaporization in `kJ/mol`
    with PC-SAFT for a list of SMILES.
    The temperature is the same for all molecules.
    The GNNPCSAFT model is used to predict
    PCSAFT parameters.

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES.
        temperature: `Temperature (K)`.

tools.name: batch_pure_vapor_pressure
tools.description:
Calculates pure vapor pressure in `Pa` with PC-SAFT for a list of SMILES.
    The temperature is the same for all molecules. The GNNPCSAFT model is used to predict
    PCSAFT parameters.

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES.
        temperature: `Temperature (K)`.

tools.name: mixture_density
tools.description:
Calculates mixture liquid density (mol/m³) with PC-SAFT.

    Args:
        parameters: A list of
         `[m, sigma, epsilon/kB, kappa_ab, epsilon_ab/kB, dipole moment, na, nb, MW]`
         for each component of the mixture.
        state: A list with the state of the mixture
         `[Temperature (K), Pressure (Pa), mole_fractions_1, mole_fractions_2, ...]`.
        kij_matrix: A matrix of binary interaction parameters.

tools.name: mixture_vapor_pressure
tools.description:
Calculates mixture `(Bubble point (Pa), Dew point (Pa))` with PC-SAFT.

    Args:
        parameters: A list of
         `[m, sigma, epsilon/kB, kappa_ab, epsilon_ab/kB, dipole moment, na, nb, MW]`
         for each component of the mixture.
        state: A list with the state of the mixture
         `[Temperature (K), Pressure (Pa), mole_fractions_1, molefractions_2, ...]`.
         The pressure should be any `float` value since it's not used in the calculation.
        kij_matrix: A matrix of binary interaction parameters.

tools.name: optimize_binary_kij_with_lle
tools.description:
Optimize the kij interaction parameter for a binary mixture with LLE
    experimental data, if available. Experimental Data is from the
    `ThermoML Archive` (https://doi.org/10.18434/mds2-2422).

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES strings [SMILE_1, SMILES_2] for the components.
        initial_kij (float): Initial guess for the kij interaction parameter.
        npoints (int): Number of candidate feed mole fractions used in flash scans.

tools.name: optimize_binary_kij_with_vle
tools.description:
Optimize the kij interaction parameter for a binary mixture with VLE
    experimental data, if available. Experimental Data is from the
    `ThermoML Archive` (https://doi.org/10.18434/mds2-2422).

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES strings [SMILE_1, SMILES_2] for the components.
        initial_kij (float): Initial guess for the kij interaction parameter.

tools.name: batch_inchi_to_smiles
tools.description:
Transform a list of InChI to SMILES.

    Args:
        inchi_list (List[str]): List of InChI.

tools.name: batch_smiles_to_inchi
tools.description:
Transform a list of SMILES to InChI.

    Args:
        smiles_list (List[str]): List of SMILES.

tools.name: batch_molecular_weights
tools.description:
Calcultes molecular weight in `g/mol` for a list of SMILES.

    Args:
      smiles (List[str]): SMILES of the molecules.
